subject.title: Mobile apps: offline session cache with instant cold open (iOS + Android)

question: Should OpenClaw accept a mobile transcript cache for iOS and Android, and what shared storage, retention, reset, attachment, and offline-read-only security contract should the platform PRs use?
rationale: The feature would persist private conversation text on mobile devices and change cold-open/offline behavior, so automation cannot choose the product/security boundary for maintainers.

options.title: Approve a shared cache contract
options.body: Define per-gateway identity, OS-protected storage, bounded text-only retention, cache reset/delete behavior, offline read-only UI, and live proof requirements before landing platform code.

options.title: Review platform PRs independently
options.body: Let each linked PR prove its own storage and reconciliation behavior, accepting higher drift risk between iOS and Android.

options.title: Defer transcript persistence
options.body: Keep the issue open but pause cache implementation until the mobile security and companion-app roadmap is clearer.

recommendation.title: Approve a shared cache contract
recommendation.body: Define per-gateway identity, OS-protected storage, bounded text-only retention, cache reset/delete behavior, offline read-only UI, and live proof requirements before landing platform code.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete owns the active linked platform-cache PRs and has the strongest current product/security routing signal for this item.
